research_question: Does one fresh Quant-H0 Worker leave official headroom on the public 13f-amendment-aware-crowding task before any public-only proposal is authorized?

trusted_failed_set_research_record_only.allowed_use: Research record and evaluator-side reconstruction only.
trusted_failed_set_research_record_only.prohibited_use: Do not place these identities, expected values, traces, or inferred predicates in Evolver evidence, public-only proposal inputs, reusable components, Worker prompts, tools, memory, routing, or candidate selection.

frozen_post_run_thresholds.effect: Retain completed accounting and stop. This frozen plan authorizes no follow-on dispatch.

terminal.next_plan_requirement: Any public-only proposal requires a separately frozen plan whose evidence excludes the trusted failed set.

retained_conclusion: One valid fresh stochastic Quant-H0 execution left four official properties of headroom on the holdings task. The request threshold was exceeded after the completed Worker call, so R1 stops with no automatic follow-on; the trusted failed set remains evaluator-side research evidence only.

claim_boundary.supported: One valid stochastic Quant-H0 official observation, aggregate headroom, exact Worker activity and request cost, post-run threshold disposition, terminal classification, service completion, and cleanup.
claim_boundary.not_supported: A stable Quant-H0 baseline, candidate quality, harness improvement, Evolver or Reviewer effectiveness, a public failure localization, benchmark-wide performance, sealed generalization, or main-experiment readiness.
claim_boundary.selection_boundary: The aggregate 47/51 result establishes headroom only. Trusted failed-test identities cannot supervise the Evolver or a future candidate.
